# Code Anchors: Drain Invocation

- `components/commands/nxs.distill.md` — run-shape resolution reads the unattended flag, strips it, and selects the unattended contract from the contract selection table.
- `components/skills/nxs-distill-unattended/SKILL.md` — the unattended contract, read only when the flag is passed: every question point becomes a stop for the whole run, the taxonomy precheck before any branch is cut, the unwind of this run's own commits, the skipped checkpoint, and the stop report.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-unattended.spec.ts` — pins the flag resolution, the contract selection row, every question point as a stop, and the unchanged attended checkpoint.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-load-ceiling.ts` — the byte ceiling on what an ordinary run loads, which kept the unattended rules out of the base stage.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-command.ts` — the shipped distill command, which starts a drain only when the lead runs it and always passes the unattended flag on the session's command line.
- `utils/close-epic.sh` — starts the drain through the shipped distill command after close succeeds.
